CREATE PROC abcd_temp_Test
AS
BEGIN

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblProperty') IS NOT NULL
	DROP TABLE #tblProperty
	
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblInspection') IS NOT NULL
	DROP TABLE #tblInspection

select 
--ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.ApplicationID ORDER BY i.ApplicationID, i.InspectionID) as RowNo, 
i.*, 
a.ApplicationNo, a.NatureOfWorks, a.ApplicationTypeID, a.Status as ApplicationStatus, a.ReferenceNo, a.Status, 
at.FSMTypeName,
TRIM(CONCAT(sa.FirstName, ' ', sa.LastName)) as Name, sa.Mobile, sa.Email
into #tblInspection
from Inspection i with(nolock)
join Application a with(nolock) on i.ApplicationID = a.ApplicationID
join ApplicationType at with(nolock) on a.ApplicationTypeID = at.ApplicationTypeID 
left join StaffAccount sa with(nolock) on i.AssignedInspectionOfficer = sa.StaffAccountID 
where
	a.LicenceID = 1 and 
	a.State = 1 and 
	--i.ScheduledDate >= '1970-01-01' and i.ScheduledDate <= '2024-12-31'
	i.ScheduledDate is null and 
	i.InspectionDecision is null --and
	--a.LicenceID = 1 and 
	--a.State = 1
--group by ApplicationID

--CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX Idx_tblInspection_ApplicationID_ApplicationTypeID_AssignedInspectionOfficer ON #tblInspection(ApplicationID,ApplicationTypeID,AssignedInspectionOfficer)
--CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX Idx_tblInspection_ApplicationID ON #tblInspection(ApplicationID)

select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.ApplicationID ORDER BY A.ApplicationID, A.PropertyID) AS PropertyRowNo, A.* into #tblProperty
--select *
from Property A with(nolock) join #tblInspection B on A.ApplicationID=B.ApplicationID

--CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX Idx_tblProperty_ApplicationID_PropertyRowNo ON #tblProperty(ApplicationID,PropertyRowNo)
--CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX Idx_tblProperty_ApplicationID ON #tblProperty(ApplicationID)
--CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX Idx_tblProperty_PropertyRowNo ON #tblProperty(PropertyRowNo)

--CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX Idx_tblInspection_ApplicationTypeID ON #tblInspection(ApplicationTypeID)
--CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX Idx_tblInspection_AssignedInspectionOfficer ON #tblInspection(AssignedInspectionOfficer)

select 
	i.*
	, ISNULL(i.ApplicationNo, i.ReferenceNo) ApplicationNo, i.NatureOfWorks, i.ApplicationTypeID, 
	ISNULL(PriProp.PropertyTypeID, MinProp.PropertyTypeID) PropertyTypeID, ISNULL(PriProp.Address, MinProp.Address) Address, ISNULL(PriProp.Suburb, MinProp.Suburb) Suburb, i.Name, i.Mobile, i.Email, i.FSMTypeName, 
	ISNULL(PriProp.PropertyID, MinProp.PropertyID) PropertyID, TRIM(ISNULL(PriProp.Longitude, MinProp.Longitude)) Longitude, TRIM(ISNULL(PriProp.Latitude, MinProp.Latitude)) Latitude, i.Status as ApplicationStatus
	--count(1)
from #tblInspection i
--join Application a on i.ApplicationID = a.ApplicationID 
left join Property PriProp with(nolock) on (i.ApplicationID = PriProp.ApplicationID and PriProp.IsPrimary = 1 ) 
--left join #tblProperty PriProp on (i.ApplicationID = PriProp.ApplicationID and PriProp.IsPrimary = 1 and i.RowNo=1) 
join #tblProperty MinProp on (i.ApplicationID = MinProp.ApplicationID and MinProp.PropertyRowNo=1) 
--where
--	a.LicenceID = 1 and 
--	a.State = 1 and 
--	i.ScheduledDate is null and 
--	i.InspectionDecision is null 
order by i.ScheduledDate, i.ScheduledTime, ISNULL(PriProp.Suburb, MinProp.Suburb)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AddGroupToChecklist]
(
	@GroupId		INT,
	@NodeSelected	INT,
	@ApplicationId	INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- CUSTOM IMPLEMENTATION FOR DELEGATE REPORTS
	DECLARE @IsAmendment BIT;
	DECLARE @ParentApplicationID INT = 0;
	SELECT  @IsAmendment = A.IsAmendment FROM Application A WHERE A.ApplicationID =@ApplicationId	
	IF(ISNULL(@IsAmendment,0) = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @ParentApplicationID = A.ApplicationID FROM Amendment A WHERE A.AmendedApplicationID = @ApplicationId ORDER BY A.AmendmentID DESC
	END

	--declare temp table to hold the hirearchy data
	DECLARE @TempHirearchy TABLE
	(
		IdentityColumn	INT IDENTITY,
		Id				INT,
		GroupId			INT,
		CategoryId		INT,
		ParentId		INT,
		GeneratedId     INT
	)

	DECLARE @GroupHirearchyId	INT

	--get the id for the group id in the CheckListTemplateGroupHirearchy table
	SELECT 
		@GroupHirearchyId = Id
	FROM	
		CheckListTemplateGroupHirearchy
	WHERE 
		GroupId = @GroupId AND CategoryId IS NULL AND ParentId IS NULL


	--get the hirearchy for the group
	;WITH ChecklistTemplateCategoryHirearchy (Id, GroupId, CategoryId, ParentId, GeneratedId) AS
	(
		SELECT 
			Id, GroupId, CategoryId, ParentId, 0
		FROM
			CheckListTemplateGroupHirearchy
		WHERE 
			Id = @GroupHirearchyId
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			cc.Id, cc.GroupId, cc.CategoryId, cc.ParentId, 0
		FROM 
			CheckListTemplateGroupHirearchy cc
			INNER JOIN ChecklistTemplateCategoryHirearchy clh
		ON 
			clh.Id = cc.ParentId
	)
	--get the child nodes only
	INSERT INTO @TempHirearchy
	SELECT * FROM ChecklistTemplateCategoryHirearchy

	--loop through the hirearchy and add it to the CheckListCategory table. 
	DECLARE @Count INT
	DECLARE @i	   INT = 1
	DECLARE @identiyGenerated INT

	--get the count to loop
	SELECT @Count = COUNT(*) FROM @TempHirearchy

	WHILE (@i <= @Count)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @id INT
		DECLARE @categoryId INT
		DECLARE @parentId	INT
		DECLARE @categoryNameToAdd	VARCHAR(MAX)
	

		SELECT 
			@id = Id, 
			@categoryId = CategoryId,
			@parentId = ParentId
		FROM
			@TempHirearchy 
		WHERE 
			IdentityColumn = @i

		IF (@categoryId IS NULL AND @parentId IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			print 'parent'
			SELECT @categoryNameToAdd = CheckListTemplateGroupName
			FROM CheckListTemplateGroup
			WHERE CheckListTemplateGroupID = @GroupId
			print @categoryNameToAdd

			--insert to CheckListCategory table under the node selected by the user
			INSERT INTO CheckListCategory
			(CategoryName, ParentId, ApplicationID, OrderCategory, OrderSubCategory, IsDeleted)
			VALUES
			(@categoryNameToAdd, @NodeSelected, @ApplicationId, NULL, 1, NULL)

			SET @identiyGenerated = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			UPDATE @TempHirearchy
			SET GeneratedId = @identiyGenerated
			WHERE IdentityColumn = @i

		
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			print 'child'
			SELECT @categoryNameToAdd = CheckListTemplateName
			FROM ChecklistTemplateCategory
			WHERE CheckListTemplateCategroyID = @categoryId
			print @categoryNameToAdd

			--insert to CheckListCategory table under the node selected by the user
			INSERT INTO CheckListCategory
			(CategoryName, ParentId, ApplicationID, OrderCategory, OrderSubCategory, IsDeleted)
			VALUES
			(@categoryNameToAdd, (SELECT GeneratedId FROM @TempHirearchy WHERE Id = @parentId), @ApplicationId, NULL, 1, NULL)

			--get the identity number generated for the insert
			SET @identiyGenerated = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			UPDATE @TempHirearchy
			SET GeneratedId = @identiyGenerated
			WHERE IdentityColumn = @i
		
		END

		--insert to CheckList table
		-- THIS IS FOR AMENDED DELEGATE REPORT
		IF(@ParentApplicationID > 0)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO CheckList
			(ApplicationID, CheckListContent, TemplateName, Comments, Status, OrderValue, IsDeleted, CategoryId,CheckListCode,YesText,NoText,PartialText)
			SELECT @ApplicationId, T.CheckListTemplateContent, @categoryNameToAdd, ISNULL([dbo].[fnGetCheckListCommentsFromParentApplication](@ParentApplicationID,T.CheckListTemplateContent,@categoryNameToAdd,@identiyGenerated),T.Comments), 0, 0 , NULL,		@identiyGenerated,T.CheckListCode,YesText,NoText,PartialText
			FROM CheckListTemplateGrouping G inner join CheckListTemplate T
			ON G.CheckListTemplateID = T.CheckListTemplateID
			WHERE GroupHirearchyId = @id
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO CheckList
			(ApplicationID, CheckListContent, TemplateName, Comments, Status, OrderValue, IsDeleted, CategoryId,CheckListCode,YesText,NoText,PartialText)
			SELECT @ApplicationId, T.CheckListTemplateContent, @categoryNameToAdd, T.Comments, 0, 0 , NULL,		@identiyGenerated,T.CheckListCode,YesText,NoText,PartialText
			FROM CheckListTemplateGrouping G inner join CheckListTemplate T
			ON G.CheckListTemplateID = T.CheckListTemplateID
			WHERE GroupHirearchyId = @id
		END
		

		SET @i = @i + 1
	END
END

-- Description:	Get Payment Info for payment receipt
-- exec spGetOnlinePaymentData 139385, 0,212835
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bkp_spGetOnlinePaymentData_11Jul2024] 
  @ApplicationID INT,
  @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID INT = 0,
  @feeId INT = 0
AS
BEGIN

--SET @feeId=0
--SET @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID=11090
DECLARE @DiscountAmount MONEY = 0;

  IF(@feeId > 0)
    BEGIN
      DECLARE @receptNo VARCHAR(300) = (SELECT TOP 1 ReceiptNo FROM Fee WHERE FeeID = @feeId)
      SET @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID = (SELECT TOP 1 OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo WHERE PayResult_BankReceiptNumber = @receptNo)
    END

  -- table 0: OnlinePaymentFeeInfo
  IF(@onlinePaymentFeeInfoID > 0)
  BEGIN
	  SELECT		
		CASE
		  WHEN a.ApplicationNo IS NULL THEN a.ReferenceNo
		  ELSE a.ApplicationNo
		END AS ApplicationNo
	   ,CASE
		  WHEN a.ApplicationNo IS NULL THEN 'Reference No'
		  ELSE 'Reference No'
		END AS ApplicationNoText
	   ,at.ApplicationTypeName AS 'ApplicationTypeName'
	   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, o.PayResult_DateTime, 100) AS 'PaymentDateTime'
	   ,o.*
	   ,a.TrackingNumber
	   ,o.PayResult_AmountSurcharge / 100 as 'PayResult_AmountSurchargeInDollars'
	  FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo o
	  JOIN Application a
		ON a.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
	  JOIN ApplicationType at
		ON a.ApplicationTypeID = at.ApplicationTypeID
	  JOIN Licence l
		ON a.LicenceID = l.LicenceID
	  WHERE OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID

	  SELECT @DiscountAmount = ISNULL(O.DiscountAmount,0.00) FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo o WHERE OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
	SELECT 
	CASE
		  WHEN ApplicationNo IS NULL THEN ReferenceNo
		  ELSE ApplicationNo
		END AS ApplicationNo
		FROM APPLIcation Where ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
  END
  

  -- table 1: Property    
  SELECT
    p.*
   , dbo.fnGetPropertyType(p.PropertyID) as PropertyTypeName
   ,b.BushfireAttackLevelDescription AS BushfireAttackLevel
  FROM dbo.[Property] p
 left join dbo.BushfireAttackLevel b on p.BushfireAttackLevelID = b.BushfireAttackLevelID
 where p.ApplicationID=@ApplicationID

  -- table 2: Applicant from ApplicationContact    
  SELECT
    a.*
   ,dbo.TRIM(ISNULL(NULLIF(firstName, '') + ' ', '') + ISNULL(NULLIF(LastName, '') + ' ', '') + ISNULL(NULLIF(company, ''), '')) AS ContactInfo
   ,CASE
      WHEN dbo.TRIM(company) = '' OR
        company IS NULL THEN dbo.TRIM(FirstName + ' ' + LastName)
      ELSE company
    END AS ApplicantName
   ,CASE
      WHEN app.ApplicantType = 0 THEN 'Agent of Owner'
      WHEN app.ApplicantType = 1 THEN 'Owner'
      ELSE 'Agent of Owner'
    END AS ApplicantTypeText
  FROM dbo.[ApplicationContact] a
  JOIN Application app
    ON a.ApplicationID = app.ApplicationID
      AND a.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
  JOIN dbo.[ContactGroup] b
    ON a.ContactGroupID = b.ContactGroupID
      AND b.ContactGroupName = 'Applicant'

  -- table 3: fee
  IF(@feeId > 0)
    BEGIN
       SELECT * FROM Fee f
          WHERE f.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID AND
          f.ReceiptNo = @receptNo
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
	DECLARE @ReciptNo VARCHAR(200) = (SELECT
            PayResult_BankReceiptNumber
          FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo
          WHERE OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID)
        SELECT
          f.*
        FROM fee f
        WHERE f.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
        AND f.ReceiptNo = @ReciptNo
       
      END
  

  -- table 4: Application
  SELECT
    [ApplicationID]
      ,[LicenceID]
      ,[ApplicationTypeID]
      ,ISNULL(NULLIF([ApplicationNo],''),[ReferenceNo]) AS 'ApplicationNo'
      ,[DateCreated]
      ,[Status]
      ,[ApplicantAccountID]
      ,[NatureOfWorks]
      ,[CostOfDevelopment]
      ,[InsuranceProvider]
      ,[InsuranceNumber]
      ,[OwnerBuilder]
      ,[AssignedStaffID]
      ,[ConsentNumber]
      ,[TrackingNumber]
      ,[State]
      ,[AssignedBuildingSurveyor]
      ,[PermitNo]
      ,[VariationNo]
      ,[InsuranceDate]
      ,[StatusChangeDate]
      ,[LevyAmount]
      ,[ClientJobNumber]
      ,[MaxFreeInspection]
      ,[LevyPlanningPermitNo]
      ,[LevyPlanningPermitDate]
      ,[LevyAllotmentOfArea]
      ,[LevyNewFloorArea]
      ,[LevyNumberOfStoreys]
      ,[LevyPersonsAccommodatedFor]
      ,[LevyAllowableLiveLoad]
      ,[LevyNoOfExistingDwellings]
      ,[LevyNoOfDwellingsDemolished]
      ,[LevyNoOfNewDwellings]
      ,[LevyFloorMaterial]
      ,[LevyFrameMaterial]
      ,[LevyRoofCladdingMaterial]
      ,[LevyExternalWallMaterial]
      ,[LevySolarHotWater]
      ,[LevyRainwaterTank]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bkp_spGetOnlinePaymentData_23Jul2024] 
  @ApplicationID INT,
  @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID INT = 0,
  @feeId INT = 0

BEGIN

--SET @feeId=0
--SET @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID=11090
DECLARE @DiscountAmount MONEY = 0;

  IF(@feeId > 0)
    BEGIN
      DECLARE @receptNo VARCHAR(300) = (SELECT TOP 1 ReceiptNo FROM Fee WHERE FeeID = @feeId)
      SET @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID = (SELECT TOP 1 OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo WHERE PayResult_BankReceiptNumber = @receptNo)
	  IF(@onlinePaymentFeeInfoID is null)
	  BEGIN
		SET @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID = (SELECT TOP 1 OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID FROM Fee WHERE FeeID = @feeId)
	  END
    END

  -- table 0: OnlinePaymentFeeInfo
  IF(@onlinePaymentFeeInfoID > 0)
  BEGIN
	  SELECT		
		CASE
		  WHEN a.ApplicationNo IS NULL THEN a.ReferenceNo
		  ELSE a.ApplicationNo
		END AS ApplicationNo
	   ,CASE
		  WHEN a.ApplicationNo IS NULL THEN 'Reference No'
		  ELSE 'Reference No'
		END AS ApplicationNoText
	   ,at.ApplicationTypeName AS 'ApplicationTypeName'
	   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, o.PayResult_DateTime, 100) AS 'PaymentDateTime'
	   ,o.*
	   ,a.TrackingNumber
	   ,o.PayResult_AmountSurcharge / 100 as 'PayResult_AmountSurchargeInDollars'
	  FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo o
	  JOIN Application a
		ON a.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
	  JOIN ApplicationType at
		ON a.ApplicationTypeID = at.ApplicationTypeID
	  JOIN Licence l
		ON a.LicenceID = l.LicenceID
	  WHERE OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID

	  SELECT @DiscountAmount = ISNULL(O.DiscountAmount,0.00) FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo o WHERE OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = @onlinePaymentFeeInfoID
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
	SELECT 
	CASE
		  WHEN ApplicationNo IS NULL THEN ReferenceNo

  -- table 1: Property    
  SELECT
    p.*
   , dbo.fnGetPropertyType(p.PropertyID) as PropertyTypeName
   ,b.BushfireAttackLevelDescription AS BushfireAttackLevel
  FROM dbo.[Property] p
 left join dbo.BushfireAttackLevel b on p.BushfireAttackLevelID = b.BushfireAttackLevelID
 where p.ApplicationID=@ApplicationID

  -- table 2: Applicant from ApplicationContact    
  SELECT
    a.*
   ,dbo.TRIM(ISNULL(NULLIF(firstName, '') + ' ', '') + ISNULL(NULLIF(LastName, '') + ' ', '') + ISNULL(NULLIF(company, ''), '')) AS ContactInfo
   ,CASE
      WHEN dbo.TRIM(company) = '' OR
        company IS NULL THEN dbo.TRIM(FirstName + ' ' + LastName)
      ELSE company
    END AS ApplicantName
   ,CASE
      WHEN app.ApplicantType = 0 THEN 'Agent of Owner'
      WHEN app.ApplicantType = 1 THEN 'Owner'
      ELSE 'Agent of Owner'
    END AS ApplicantTypeText
  FROM dbo.[ApplicationContact] a
  JOIN Application app
    ON a.ApplicationID = app.ApplicationID
      AND a.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
  JOIN dbo.[ContactGroup] b

      AND b.ContactGroupName = 'Applicant'
  
  -- Is Full Discount
  Declare @IsFullDiscount char(1) = 'N', @vReceiptNo varchar(50) = ''
  IF(SELECT SUM(Amount + GST) - @DiscountAmount FROM Fee WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID AND (Fee.ReceiptNo = @receptNo OR Fee.OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = ISNULL(@onlinePaymentFeeInfoID, Fee.OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID))) = 0

	   FROM Fee f
          WHERE f.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID AND

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[bkp_spSearchApplication_19Feb2024] @LicenceID INT, @DepartmentID INT, @ApplicationTypeID VARCHAR(100), @ApplicationNo VARCHAR(100), @Status VARCHAR(1000), @NatureOfWorks VARCHAR(100), @Description VARCHAR(100),
@Address VARCHAR(200), @PropertyNo VARCHAR(100), @PermitNo VARCHAR(100), @FirstName VARCHAR(100), @LastName VARCHAR(100), @Company VARCHAR(100),
@AssignedStaffID INT = NULL, @AssignedBuildingSurveyor INT = NULL, @ContactGroupID INT = NULL,
@DecisionDateFrom DATETIME = NULL, @DecisionDateTo DATETIME = NULL, @DecisionType VARCHAR(250) = NULL,
@ReferenceNo VARCHAR(100) = NULL, @StatusGroupName VARCHAR(100) = NULL, @LotNo VARCHAR(300) = NULL, @SectionNo VARCHAR(300) = NULL, @PlanNo VARCHAR(300) = NULL,
@PageNumber INT, @PageSize INT, @PsNo VARCHAR(50), @TagName VARCHAR(1000) = NULL, @InitiatedBy tinyint = NULL, @TradingName VARCHAR(5000) = NULL, @RegisterationExpiryDate DATE = NULL, @ParkingPermitName VARCHAR(50) = NULL
,@ApplicantAccountID INT = NULL ,@SignoffStaffID INT =NULL, @FileLocation VARCHAR(MAX) = NULL

AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @query VARCHAR(MAX)
  DECLARE @sql VARCHAR(MAX)
  DECLARE @viewSql VARCHAR(MAX)
  DECLARE @showField VARCHAR(MAX)
  DECLARE @groupField VARCHAR(MAX)

   -- Setting tag names from ids
  DECLARE @TagNameStr VARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
  IF (@TagName IS NOT NULL)
  BEGIN 
    SET @TagNameStr = (SELECT '''' + STRING_AGG(REPLACE(TagName,'''',''''''), ''', ''') + '''' FROM Tag WHERE TagID IN (SELECT Item FROM fnSplitString(@TagName,',')))
  END

  SET @sql = 'select a.ApplicationID, a.DateCreated, a.ApplicationNo, a.ReferenceNo,a.DateSubmitted,a.ApplicationNoGenDate from Application a '
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join Property p on (a.ApplicationID = p.ApplicationID) '
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join ApplicationTypeSetting ats on a.LicenceID = ats.LicenceID and a.ApplicationTypeID = ats.ApplicationTypeID '
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join ApplicationContact ac on a.ApplicationID = ac.ApplicationID '
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join Decision d on a.ApplicationID = d.ApplicationID '
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join ApplicationTag at on a.ApplicationID = at.ApplicationID '
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join ParkingPermit pp on a.ApplicationID = pp.ApplicationID '
  --	set @sql = @sql + 'left join DecisionType dtype on d.DecisionTypeID = dtype.DecisionTypeID '
  
  -- Add Parking Permit Type
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join ParkingPermitType ppt on pp.ParkingPermitTypeID = ppt.ParkingPermitTypeID '

  -- Add Secondary Consent
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join SecondaryConsentRequest sc on a.ApplicationID = sc.ApplicationID '

  -- Add Extension of Time Request
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join ExtensionOfTimeRequest eot on a.ApplicationID = eot.ApplicationID '

  -- Add Request to Endorse Plans
  SET @sql = @sql + 'left join RequestToEndorsePlans rep on a.ApplicationID = rep.ApplicationID '

  SET @sql = @sql + 'where a.LicenceID = ' + CAST(@LicenceID AS VARCHAR) + ' and a.State = 1'

  IF (@ParkingPermitName != '')
  BEGIN
    SET @sql = @sql + ' and ppt.PermitName like ''%' + @ParkingPermitName + '%''';
  END


  IF (@DepartmentID != 0)
  BEGIN
    SET @sql = @sql + ' and ats.DepartmentID = ' + CAST(@DepartmentID AS VARCHAR);
  END

  IF (@InitiatedBy != 0)
  BEGIN
    SET @sql = @sql + ' and a.InitiatedBy like ''%' + CAST(@InitiatedBy AS VARCHAR) + '%''';
  END

  IF (@TradingName != '')
  BEGIN
    SET @sql = @sql + ' and ac.TradingName like ''%' + @TradingName + '%''';
  END
  IF (@RegisterationExpiryDate IS NOT NULL)
  BEGIN
    SET @sql = @sql + ' and ac.RegisterationExpiryDate = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @RegisterationExpiryDate, 20) + '''';
  END



  IF (@ApplicationTypeID != '0')
  BEGIN
    SET @sql = @sql + ' and a.ApplicationTypeID IN (' + @ApplicationTypeID + ')';
  END

  IF (@ApplicationNo != '')
  BEGIN
    SET @sql = @sql + ' and (a.ApplicationNo like ''%' + @ApplicationNo + '%'' or a.ReferenceNo like ''%' + @ApplicationNo + '%'')';
  END

 Description varchar(250),

(   BuildingPermitNo,

 OPCFIDate

dbo.GetBuildingPermitDecisionDate(RelatedBuildingPermit.ApplicationID) as BuildingPermitDate,

left join ApplicationContact ap on ap.ApplicationID = RelatedBuildingPermit.ApplicationID      
left join ContactGroup cg on (ap.ContactGroupID = cg.ContactGroupID and cg.ContactGroupName='Building Surveyor')         
  
  
select * from @buildingPermitHistory;

 --table 10: Licence  
  select CompanyName,

        Postal_Address, Postal_Suburb, Postal_PostCode, Postal_State,

        ApplicantPortalDomain + '/application/detail/' + a.TrackingNumber COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT as 'URLApplicantPortalMyAppDetails'  
 from licence l

 -- table 11: Condition                
 select *                 
 from dbo.[Condition]                 
 where ApplicationID = @ApplicationID                
 order by OrderValue 

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DeleteCheckListCategory]
(
	@CategoryId INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @TempHirearchey TABLE
	(
	Id INT, 
	CategroyName VARCHAR(MAX), 
	ParentId INT,
	IsDeleted BIT
	)

	--get the hirearchy for the node that is to marked as deleted 
	;WITH ChecklistCategoryHirearchy (Id, CategroyName, ParentId, IsDeleted) AS
	(
		SELECT 
			Id, CategoryName, ParentId, IsDeleted
		FROM
			ChecklistCategory
		WHERE 
			Id = @CategoryId
		UNION ALL
		SELECT 
			cc.Id, cc.CategoryName, cc.ParentId, cc.IsDeleted
		FROM 
			ChecklistCategory cc
			INNER JOIN ChecklistCategoryHirearchy clh
		ON 
			clh.Id = cc.ParentId
	)
	--get the child nodes only
	INSERT INTO @TempHirearchey
	SELECT * FROM ChecklistCategoryHirearchy

	--update the checklist items with isDeleted True
	UPDATE CheckList
	SET IsDeleted  = 1
	WHERE CategoryId 
	IN (SELECT Id FROM @TempHirearchey)

	--update checklist category with isDeleted True
	UPDATE ChecklistCategory
	SET IsDeleted = 1
	WHERE Id
	IN (SELECT Id FROM @TempHirearchey)
END

-- =============================================

-- Description: Get values from application table related tables expression should be following format [%TABLE_NAME#COLUMN_NAME#%].                      
-- EXEC GetApplicationTableRelatedValues N'[%ApplicationNo%]', @ApplicationId=316080, @DocumentId=254391, @CurrentStaffID=1, @ReferralAgencyID=0, @InspectionID=0, @AddresseeType='',   
-- @AddresseeID=0, @ApplicantAccountID=0, @IsRelationOnly=0, @RelationDocID=0, @ReturnValue OUT;                 
-- =============================================               
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetApplicationTableRelatedValues]        
(          
  @expression VARCHAR(MAX),          
  @applicationId INT,          
  @documentId INT,        
  @CurrentStaffID int = 0,        
  @ReferralAgencyID int = 0,        
  @InspectionID int = 0,        
  @AddresseeType varchar(100)='',        
  @AddresseeID int = 0,        
  @ApplicantAccountID INT = 0,        
  @IsRelationOnly bit = 0,        
  @RelationDocID int =0  ,      
  @ReturnValue NVARCHAR(100) OUT          
)          
AS           
BEGIN          
  DECLARE @TableName VARCHAR(MAX);          
  DECLARE @ColumnName VARCHAR(MAX);          
  DECLARE @SubStr VARCHAR(MAX);              
  DECLARE @UploadedBy INT      
          
  SET @SubStr = REPLACE(REPLACE(@expression,'%]', ''),'[%', '');      
      
  SELECT @UploadedBy = D.UploadedBy FROM Document D WHERE D.DocumentID =  @DocumentID      
    
  -- Application Fields      
  IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationDateCreated'      
  BEGIN    
 SELECT  @ReturnValue = CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX), DateCreated)       
 FROM Application      
 WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'DateConstructed'
  BEGIN
	SELECT	TOP(1)  @ReturnValue = COALESCE(ConstructionDate, '') 
	FROM	RegisterItem
	WHERE	ApplicationID = @applicationId  
  END
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationId'    
  BEGIN    
 SET @ReturnValue = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), @applicationId)    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationNo'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(ApplicationNo, '')      
 FROM Application      
 WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationStatus'     
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = Status      
    FROM Application      
    WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationNatureOfWork'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(NatureOfWorks, '')    
    FROM Application      
    WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationTrackingNo'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(TrackingNumber,'')    
    FROM Application      
    WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationPermitNo'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(PermitNo,'')    
    FROM Application      
    WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId    
  END
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'SpearNo'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue =fileLocation    
    FROM Application      
    WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId    
  END
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationReferenceNo'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(ReferenceNo,'')    
    FROM Application      
    WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicantName'  
  BEGIN  
	--SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(FirstName, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(Surname,'') +' '+ COALESCE(Company,'')  
	--FROM ApplicantAccount  
	--WHERE ApplicantAccountID = @ApplicantAccountID  
	SELECT	TOP(1) @ReturnValue = COALESCE(FirstName, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(LastName, '') +' '+ COALESCE(Company, '')
	FROM	ApplicationContact
	WHERE	ApplicationID = @applicationId
			AND
			ContactGroupID = 1
  END
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'Complianant'
  BEGIN
    SELECT    TOP(1) @ReturnValue = COALESCE(FirstName, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(LastName,'') +' '+ COALESCE(Company,'')
    FROM    ApplicationContact
    WHERE    ApplicationId = @applicationId
	AND ContactGroupID = 25
            
  END
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'PermitYear'  
  BEGIN  
 SELECT @ReturnValue = YEAR(DateCreated)  
 FROM Application  
 WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId  
  END
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'DocumentType'  
  BEGIN  
 SELECT @ReturnValue = dt.DocumentTypeName  
 FROM Document d join DocumentType dt on d.DocumentTypeID=dt.DocumentTypeID  
 WHERE d.DocumentID = @documentId  
  END 
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'ApplicationOwner'  
  BEGIN  
	SELECT	TOP(1) @ReturnValue = COALESCE(FirstName, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(LastName,'') +' '+ COALESCE(Company,'')  
	FROM	ApplicationContact  
	WHERE	ContactGroupID = 7  
			AND  
			ApplicationId = @applicationId  
  END  
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'CustomerName'  
  BEGIN  
 SELECT TOP(1) @ReturnValue = COALESCE(FirstName, '') + ' ' + COALESCE(LastName,'') +' '+ COALESCE(Company,'')  
 FROM ApplicationContact  
 WHERE ContactGroupID = 1  
   AND  
   ApplicationId = @applicationId  
  END 
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'LP_PS'   
  BEGIN   
 SELECT TOP(1) @ReturnValue = COALESCE(LP_PS,'')     
    FROM Property     
    WHERE ApplicationId = @applicationId   
 ORDER BY PropertyID   
  END
   ELSE IF @SubStr = 'NoOfLots'   
  BEGIN   
 SELECT @ReturnValue =NumberOfLotsYield   
    FROM Application     
    WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId   
  END
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'Decision'   
  BEGIN   
 SELECT TOP(1) @ReturnValue = COALESCE(dt.Description ,'')  
    FROM Decision  d
    join DecisionType dt on d.DecisionTypeID =dt.DecisionTypeID
    WHERE ApplicationID = @applicationId  
  END
  -- Document Fields    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'DocumentName'  
  BEGIN  
 SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(FileName, '')      
    FROM Document      
    WHERE DocumentID = @documentId     
  END  
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'DocumentComments'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(Comments, '')      
    FROM Document      
    WHERE DocumentID = @documentId    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'DocumentUploaderName'     
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(UploaderName,'')      
    FROM Document      
    WHERE DocumentID = @documentId    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'DocumentDateInserted'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT @ReturnValue = CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),DateInserted)      
    FROM Document      
    WHERE DocumentID = @documentId    
  END    
  -- Property Fields    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'PropertyNo'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT TOP(1) @ReturnValue = COALESCE(PropertyNo,'')      
    FROM Property      
    WHERE ApplicationId = @applicationId    
 ORDER BY PropertyID    
  END    
  ELSE IF @SubStr = 'PropertyAddress'    
  BEGIN    
 SELECT TOP(1) @ReturnValue = Address    
 FROM Property    
 WHERE ApplicationId = @applicationId    
 ORDER BY PropertyID    
  END    
 -- Uploader Details      
 -- 0: Applicant; 1: Staff; 2: Referral; 3: System; 4: Inspector     
 ELSE IF @SubStr = 'AuthorEmailAddress'    
 BEGIN    
  IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 0    
  BEGIN    
   SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(AA.Email, '')    
            FROM ApplicantAccount AS AA      
     INNER JOIN      
     Licence AS L      
     ON AA.LicenceID = L.LicenceID      
            WHERE AA.ApplicantAccountId = @ApplicantAccountID    
  END    
  ELSE IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 1    
  BEGIN    
   IF NULLIF(@AddresseeType,'') IS NOT NULL AND @AddresseeID > 0    
   BEGIN    
    IF @AddresseeType = 'Applicant' OR @AddresseeType = 'Owner'    
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(Email, '')    
     FROM ApplicationContact      
     WHERE ApplicationContactID =  @AddresseeID    
    END    
   END    
  END    
  ELSE IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 3    
  BEGIN    
   IF NULLIF(@AddresseeType,'') IS NOT NULL AND @AddresseeID > 0    
   BEGIN    
    -- WorkFlow Addressee     
    IF @AddresseeType = 'Applicant' OR @AddresseeType = 'Owner'     
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(Email, '')    
     FROM ApplicationContact      
     WHERE ApplicationContactID =  @AddresseeID    
    END    
    -- Online Payment     
    IF @AddresseeType = 'OnlinePayment'    
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(Payee_Email, '')      
                    FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo      
                    WHERE OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = @AddresseeID    
    END    
   END    
  END    
 END    
 ELSE IF @SubStr = 'AuthorFirstName'     
 BEGIN    
  IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 0    
  BEGIN    
   SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(L.Description, '')    
            FROM ApplicantAccount AS AA      
     INNER JOIN      
     Licence AS L      
     ON AA.LicenceID = L.LicenceID      
            WHERE AA.ApplicantAccountId = @ApplicantAccountID    
  END    
  ELSE IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 1    
  BEGIN    
   IF NULLIF(@AddresseeType,'') IS NOT NULL AND @AddresseeID > 0    
   BEGIN    
    IF @AddresseeType = 'Applicant' OR @AddresseeType = 'Owner'    
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(FirstName, '')    
     FROM ApplicationContact      
     WHERE ApplicationContactID =  @AddresseeID    
    END    
   END    
  END    
  ELSE IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 3    
  BEGIN    
   IF NULLIF(@AddresseeType,'') IS NOT NULL AND @AddresseeID > 0    
   BEGIN    
    -- WorkFlow Addressee     
    IF @AddresseeType = 'Applicant' OR @AddresseeType = 'Owner'     
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(FirstName, '')    
     FROM ApplicationContact      
     WHERE ApplicationContactID =  @AddresseeID    
    END    
    -- Online Payment     
    IF @AddresseeType = 'OnlinePayment'    
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(Payee_FirstName, '')      
                    FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo      
                    WHERE OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = @AddresseeID    
    END    
   END    
  END    
 END    
 ELSE IF @SubStr = 'AuthorLastName'     
 BEGIN    
  IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 0    
  BEGIN    
   SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(L.Description, '')    
            FROM ApplicantAccount AS AA      
     INNER JOIN      
     Licence AS L      
     ON AA.LicenceID = L.LicenceID      
            WHERE AA.ApplicantAccountId = @ApplicantAccountID    
  END    
  ELSE IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 1    
  BEGIN    
   IF NULLIF(@AddresseeType,'') IS NOT NULL AND @AddresseeID > 0    
   BEGIN    
    IF @AddresseeType = 'Applicant' OR @AddresseeType = 'Owner'    
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(LastName, '')    
     FROM ApplicationContact      
     WHERE ApplicationContactID =  @AddresseeID    
    END    
   END    
  END    
  ELSE IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 3    
  BEGIN    
   IF NULLIF(@AddresseeType,'') IS NOT NULL AND @AddresseeID > 0    
   BEGIN    
    -- WorkFlow Addressee     
    IF @AddresseeType = 'Applicant' OR @AddresseeType = 'Owner'     
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(LastName, '')    
     FROM ApplicationContact      
     WHERE ApplicationContactID =  @AddresseeID    
    END    
    -- Online Payment     
    IF @AddresseeType = 'OnlinePayment'    
    BEGIN    
     SELECT @ReturnValue = COALESCE(Payee_LastName, '')      
                    FROM OnlinePaymentFeeInfo      
                    WHERE OnlinePaymentFeeInfoID = @AddresseeID    
    END    
   END    
  END    
 END    
 ELSE IF @SubStr = 'IsInternalAddressee'     
 BEGIN    
  IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 0      
  BEGIN    
   SET @ReturnValue = 'true';    
  END    
  ELSE IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 1     
  BEGIN    
   IF NULLIF(@AddresseeType,'') IS NOT NULL AND @AddresseeID > 0    
   BEGIN    
    IF @AddresseeType = 'Applicant' OR @AddresseeType = 'Owner'    
    BEGIN    
     SET @ReturnValue = 'false';    
    END    
   END    
  END    
  ELSE IF @UploadedBy IS NOT NULL AND @UploadedBy = 3    
  BEGIN    
   IF NULLIF(@AddresseeType,'') IS NOT NULL AND @AddresseeID > 0    
   BEGIN    
    IF @AddresseeType = 'Applicant' OR @AddresseeType = 'Owner' OR @AddresseeType = 'OnlinePayment'    
    BEGIN    
     SET @ReturnValue = 'false';    
    END    
   END    
  END    
 END    
    
 IF ISNULL(@ReturnValue, '') = ''    
 BEGIN    
  SET @ReturnValue = '';    
 END    
      
  RETURN;          
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SANSearch]
(
   @SearchStr nvarchar(100)
)
AS
BEGIN

CREATE TABLE #Results (ColumnName nvarchar(370), ColumnValue nvarchar(3630))

   SET NOCOUNT ON

   DECLARE @TableName nvarchar(256), @ColumnName nvarchar(128), @SearchStr2 nvarchar(110)
   SET  @TableName = ''
   SET @SearchStr2 = QUOTENAME('%' + @SearchStr + '%','''')

   WHILE @TableName IS NOT NULL
   BEGIN
      SET @ColumnName = ''
      SET @TableName = 
      (
         SELECT MIN(QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME))
         FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
         WHERE       TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
            AND   QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME) > @TableName
            AND   OBJECTPROPERTY(
                  OBJECT_ID(
                     QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME)
                      ), 'IsMSShipped'
                         ) = 0
      )

      WHILE (@TableName IS NOT NULL) AND (@ColumnName IS NOT NULL)
      BEGIN
         SET @ColumnName =
         (
            SELECT MIN(QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME))
            FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
            WHERE       TABLE_SCHEMA   = PARSENAME(@TableName, 2)
               AND   TABLE_NAME   = PARSENAME(@TableName, 1)
               AND   DATA_TYPE IN ('char', 'varchar', 'nchar', 'nvarchar')
               AND   QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME) > @ColumnName
         )
   
         IF @ColumnName IS NOT NULL
         BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #Results
            EXEC
            (
               'SELECT ''' + @TableName + '.' + @ColumnName + ''', LEFT(' + @ColumnName + ', 3630) 
               FROM ' + @TableName + ' (NOLOCK) ' +
               ' WHERE ' + @ColumnName + ' LIKE ' + @SearchStr2
            )
         END
      END   
   END

   SELECT ColumnName, ColumnValue FROM #Results
END

AS
BEGIN

-- Copyright © 2002 Narayana Vyas Kondreddi. All rights reserved.
-- Purpose: To search all columns of all tables for a given search string
-- Written by: Narayana Vyas Kondreddi

SET  @TableName = ''
SET @SearchStr2 = QUOTENAME('%' + @SearchStr + '%','''')

WHILE @TableName IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SET @ColumnName = ''
    SET @TableName = 
    (
        SELECT MIN(QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME))
        FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
        WHERE       TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
            AND QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME) > @TableName
            AND OBJECTPROPERTY(
                    OBJECT_ID(

                         ), 'IsMSShipped'
                           ) = 0
    )

    WHILE (@TableName IS NOT NULL) AND (@ColumnName IS NOT NULL)

        SET @ColumnName =

            SELECT MIN(QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME))
            FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
            WHERE       TABLE_SCHEMA    = PARSENAME(@TableName, 2)

    END 
END

SELECT ColumnName, ColumnValue FROM @Results

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCompleteReminder]
	@PermitReminderID INT
AS
BEGIN

	--SET @PermitReminderID =1

DECLARE @LicenceID INT
DECLARE @DayCount INT
DECLARE @ApplicationTypeID INT


SET @DayCount = (SELECT TOP 1 DaysToRemind FROM PermitReminder WHERE PermitReminderID=@PermitReminderID)
SET @LicenceID = (SELECT TOP 1 LicenceID FROM PermitReminder WHERE PermitReminderID=@PermitReminderID)
SET @ApplicationTypeID = (SELECT TOP 1 ApplicationTypeID FROM PermitReminder WHERE PermitReminderID=@PermitReminderID)

--SELECT @DayCount

DECLARE @StartDate DATETIME
DECLARE @EndDate DATETIME

SET @StartDate = (SELECT DATEADD(Day, @DayCount, GETDATE()) AS DateAdd);
SET @EndDate = (SELECT DATEADD(Day, (@DayCount+1), GETDATE()) AS DateAdd);

SET @StartDate = (SELECT CAST(@StartDate AS date))
SET @EndDate = (SELECT CAST(@EndDate AS date))


SELECT a.ApplicationID,d.CompletedByDate as EffectDate,d.decisionid as DecisionID,
	CASE 
		WHEN EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 de2.DecisionID FROM Decision de2 INNER JOIN DecisionType dt2 ON dt2.DecisionTypeID=de2.DecisionTypeID  WHERE de2.ApplicationID = a.ApplicationID 
			AND dt2.MetaType IN (3,4,6,7,8,9) ) THEN 'Y'
		ELSE 'N'
	END AS IsIssued	
	into #tempResult
	FROM Application a
	INNER JOIN Decision d ON d.ApplicationID= a.ApplicationID AND 
		d.DecisionID = (SELECT TOP 1 DecisionID FROM Decision de WHERE de.ApplicationID = a.ApplicationID ORDER BY de.DateDecision desc , de.DecisionID desc )
	INNER JOIN DecisionType dt ON dt.DecisionTypeID = d.DecisionTypeID
	WHERE a.LicenceID = @LicenceID AND a.Status != 'Complete' AND a.Status != 'Cancelled' and a.Status!='Lapsed' 
	AND (d.CompletedByDate >= @StartDate AND d.CompletedByDate < @EndDate )
	AND (DateLapsed is null or DateLapsed>GETDATE())
	AND dt.MetaType IN(1,2,5,10)
	AND a.ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID AND a.OfficeID IS NULL
	ORDER BY ApplicationID
	
	SELECT ApplicationID,EffectDate,DecisionID FROM #tempResult WHERE IsIssued='N'
	DROP TABLE #tempResult



END

		where a.LicenceID = @LicenceID 
		and a.State = 1 
		and (@ApplicantAccountID is null or a.ApplicantAccountID = @ApplicantAccountID)

@DatePrior dateTime

)

	DECLARE @Errors TABLE
	(

		ValidationMessage	VARCHAR(MAX)
	)

	IF ((SELECT Description FROM Application WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID) IS NULL 
	   OR
	    (SELECT Description FROM Application WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID) = '' 
	   )
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Errors VALUES ('ApplicationDescription', 'Application description cannot be empty')
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT BCAClassificationContent FROM BCAClassification WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID)
	BEGIN

	END

		OR

	)
	BEGIN

	END

	--check LevyExistingFloorArea
	IF ((SELECT LevyExistingFloorArea FROM Application WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID) IS NULL
		OR
		(TRY_CAST((SELECT LevyExistingFloorArea FROM Application WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) IS NULL)
	)
	BEGIN

	END

	--check current use of building parts

	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Errors VALUES ('CurrentUseOfBuildingPart', 'No recrods found for Current Use Of BuildingPart for the Application')
	END

	--Check for wall materials
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ApplicationLevyExternalWallMaterial WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Errors VALUES ('WallMaterials', 'No wall materials selected for the Application')
	END

	--Check for roof materials
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ApplicationLevyRoofCladdingMaterial WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Errors VALUES ('RoofMaterials', 'No roof materials selected for the Application')
	END

	--Check for floor materials
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ApplicationLevyFloorMaterial WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Errors VALUES ('RoofMaterials', 'No floor materials selected for the Application')
	END

	--Check for frame materials
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ApplicationLevyFrameMaterial WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Errors VALUES ('RoofMaterials', 'No frame materials selected for the Application')
	END

	--return errors
	SELECT * FROM @Errors
END

 WHILE @count < @DynamicOccurrences        
 BEGIN

  SET @StartPos = CHARINDEX('[',@PropertyValue );

   CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(meta.value) as lines;         
        
 WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #meta)            
 BEGIN          
  DECLARE @MetaRowId INT;

  DECLARE @MetaValue VARCHAR(MAX);            
  DECLARE @JsonIndex VARCHAR(30);           
        
  SELECT TOP 1 @MetaRowId = RowId,            
    @JsonIndex = [index],

  SET @count = 0;

  SELECT @DynamicOccurrences = (LEN(@MetaValue) - LEN(REPLACE(@MetaValue, @FindSubString, '')))/LEN(@FindSubString);        
        
  WHILE @count < @DynamicOccurrences        
  BEGIN        
   SET @StartPos = CHARINDEX('[',@MetaValue );         
   SET @EndPos = CHARINDEX(']',@MetaValue );         
   SET @Length = @EndPos - @StartPos;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spExportAppData]
	@LicenceID int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DECLARE @AppList table 
	(
		AppID int,
		ApplicationNo varchar(20)
	)
	
	insert @AppList
	select applicationid, ApplicationNo
	from Application
	where LicenceID = @LicenceID and [State] = 1
	
	-- Table 0: Application Details
	/*select * from Application a 
	join @AppList al on a.ApplicationID = al.AppID*/
	
	select  a.ApplicationNo,
		    DateCreated,
		    sa.Name,
			a.[Status],
			NatureOfWorks,
			CostOfDevelopment,
			InsuranceProvider,
			InsuranceNumber,
			OwnerBuilder,
			ConsentNumber as OwnerBuilderConsentNumber,
			PermitNo,
			InsuranceDate,
			ClientJobNumber,
			LevyPlanningPermitNo,
			LevyPlanningPermitDate,
			LevyAllotmentOfArea,
			LevyNewFloorArea,
			LevyNumberOfStoreys,
			LevyPersonsAccommodatedFor,
			LevyAllowableLiveLoad,
			LevyNoOfExistingDwellings,
			LevyNoOfNewDwellings,
			LevyFloorMaterial,
			LevyFrameMaterial,
			LevyRoofCladdingMaterial,
			LevyExternalWallMaterial,
			LevySolarHotWater,
			LevyRainwaterTank,
			PreviousPermitNumber,
			NatureOfWorkCode,
			StageDescription,
			TotalProjectCost,
			LevyDualPlumbing,
			LevyExistingFloorArea,
			LevyEnergyRating
    from Application a 
	join @AppList al on a.ApplicationID = al.AppID 
	left join StaffAccount sa on a.AssignedBuildingSurveyor = sa.StaffAccountID

	-- Table 1: Get Property
	/*select p.*, al.ApplicationNo
	from dbo.Property p
	join @AppList al on al.AppID = p.applicationid*/
	
	select	al.ApplicationNo,
			Description,
			StreetNumber,
			StreetName,
			Suburb,
			State,
			Postcode,
			Address,
			CrownAllotmentNo,
			SectionNo,
			ParishName,
			MunicipalDistrict,
			LP_PS,
			PlanNo,
			Volume,
			Folio,
			AreaOfNewBuildingWork,
			Termites,
			FloodProne,
			BushfireProne,
			DesignatedLand,
			AlpineArea,
			DeclaredRoad,
			TownPlanningPermit,
			Country,
			AllotmentArea,
			LotNo,
			PlanningPermitNo,
			PlanningPermitDate,
			MelwayRef,
			bal.BushfireAttackLevelDescription,
			Locality,
			County,
			Zonning
	from dbo.Property p
	join @AppList al on al.AppID = p.applicationid
	left join dbo.BushfireAttackLevel bal on p.BushfireAttackLevelID = bal.BushfireAttackLevelID

	
	-- Table 2: Application Contact
	select al.ApplicationNo,
	       [FirstName]
		  ,[LastName]
		  ,[Email]
		  ,[Phone]
		  ,[Title]
		  ,[Company]
		  ,[AD_StreetNumber]
		  ,[AD_StreetName]
		  ,[AD_Suburb]
		  ,[AD_State]
		  ,[AD_Postcode]
		  ,cg.ContactGroupName
		  ,[Fax]
		  ,[AD_Country]
		  ,[CategoryClass]
		  ,[RegNumber]
		  ,CASE
			  WHEN  [PractitionerType] = 0 THEN 'To be engaged'
			  WHEN  [PractitionerType] = 1 THEN 'Were engaged'
			  ELSE '' 
		   END as PractitionerType
		  ,[Address]
		  ,[Mobile]
		  ,[PostPermitEmail]
		  ,[Postal_StreetNumber]
		  ,[Postal_StreetName]
		  ,[Postal_Suburb]
		  ,[Postal_State]
		  ,[Postal_Country]
		  ,[Postal_Postcode]
	from dbo.ApplicationContact ac
	join @AppList al on ac.ApplicationID = al.AppID
	join ContactGroup cg on ac.ContactGroupID = cg.ContactGroupID
	
	-- Table 3: BCA Classification
	select al.ApplicationNo
		   ,[BCAClassificationContent]
		   ,[PartOfBuilding]
		   ,[AllowableLiveLoad]
		   ,[PersonsAccommodated]
		   ,[PermittedUse]
	from dbo.BCAClassification bca
	join @AppList al on bca.ApplicationID = al.AppID
	
	-- Table 4: Decision
	select al.ApplicationNo
		   ,CASE
			  WHEN  dt.MetaType = 1 THEN 'Building Permit - OP Required'
			  WHEN  dt.MetaType = 2 THEN 'Building Permit - CFI Required'
			  WHEN  dt.MetaType = 3 THEN 'OP'
			  WHEN  dt.MetaType = 4 THEN 'CFI'
			  ELSE '' 
		   END as PractitionerType
           ,[DateDecision]
           ,[CompletedByDate]
           ,[CommencedByDate]
	from dbo.Decision d
	join @AppList al on d.ApplicationID = al.AppID
	join dbo.DecisionType dt on d.DecisionTypeID = dt.DecisionTypeID
	
	-- Table 5: Inspection
	select al.ApplicationNo
		   ,[ScheduledDate]
		   ,[Notes]
		   ,ia.Name as InspectorName
		   ,[InspectionType]
		   ,CASE
			  WHEN  InspectionDecision = 0 THEN 'Approved'
			  WHEN  InspectionDecision = 1 THEN 'Not Approved'
			  WHEN  InspectionDecision = 2 THEN 'Approved Subject To'
			  WHEN  InspectionDecision = 3 THEN 'Not Approved - Re Inspection Required'
			  ELSE '' 
		    END as InspectionResult
		   ,[InspectionDate]
		   ,[ScheduledTime]
		   ,[ContactPersonName] as SiteContact
		   ,[ContactPersonMobile] as SiteContactMobile
		   ,[Comments]
	from dbo.Inspection i
	join @AppList al on i.ApplicationID = al.AppID
	left join InspectorAccount ia on i.InspectionOfficer = ia.InspectorAccountID
	
	-- Table 6: Fees
	SELECT al.ApplicationNo
           ,[FeeItem]
           ,[Amount] as TotalAmount
           ,gst
		   ,ft.FeeTypeName
    FROM  [Fee] f
	join @AppList al on f.ApplicationID = al.AppID
	join FeeType ft on ft.FeeTypeID = f.FeeTypeID
	
	-- Table 7: Document
	select d.DocumentID,
	       al.ApplicationNo
	       ,[DateInserted]
		   ,[Comments]
		   ,[FileName]
		   ,[Path]
		   ,dt.DocumentTypeName
		   ,[ApplicantAccess]
		   ,[ApplicantClientAccess]
		   ,[State]
	from dbo.Document d
	join @AppList al on d.ApplicationID = al.AppID and d.State = 1
	left join DocumentType dt on d.DocumentTypeID = dt.DocumentTypeID
	
END

			from GISLotNumber as l
			inner join GISStreetNumber as sn
				on l.GISStreetNumberID = sn.GISStreetNumberID
			inner join GISStreet as st
				on sn.GISStreetID = st.GISStreetID
			inner join GISSuburb as s
				on st.GISSuburbID = s.GISSuburbID
			where l.propertyFileNo like @KeyWord
			AND l.LicenceId =  @LicenceID
			AND sn.LicenceId = @LicenceID
			AND st.LicenceId = @LicenceID
			AND s.LicenceId = @LicenceID

	sn.StreetNumber,
	st.GISStreetID,
	st.StreetName,
	s.GISSuburbID,
	s.SuburbName,
	s.PostCode
	,GS.Abbreviation AS State

	inner join GISStreetNumber as sn

	inner join GISStreet as st

	inner join GISSuburb as s

	inner join GISSuburb as s

	LEFT JOIN Licence Li

 DECLARE @LicenceID int    
 DECLARE @ApplicationTypeID int    
 DECLARE @PermitNo varchar(20)    
 DECLARE @PermitNoPrefix varchar(20)    
 DECLARE @PermitNoSuffix int    
 DECLARE @NumofPreviousStages int    
 DECLARE @ProjectCost money    
 declare @location int    
 declare @start int    
 declare @length int    
 DECLARE @iApplicationNo varchar(20)    
     
 -- get default application number

 from dbo.[Application]

 DECLARE @PreviousStageDescription TABLE    
 (    
   StageDescription varchar(250),    
   PermitNo varchar(20),   
   ApplicationNo varchar(20),    
   DateDecision datetime,    
   BPNumber varchar(50)    
 )    
    
 select @NumofPreviousStages = null;    
 select @PermitNoSuffix = null;    
    
 select @LicenceID = LicenceID, @ApplicationTypeID = ApplicationTypeID, @PermitNo = PermitNo from Application where ApplicationID = @ApplicationID    
 if (@PermitNo != '' and @PermitNo is not null)    
 begin    
  set @PermitNo = ltrim(rtrim(@PermitNo))    
  set @location = charindex('/',@PermitNo)     
  if(@location > 0)    
  begin    
   set @PermitNoPrefix = substring(@PermitNo, 0 ,@location )    
   set @PermitNoSuffix = substring(@PermitNo, @location + 1, len(@PermitNo) - @location)    
  end    
  if(@PermitNoSuffix > 1)    
  begin    
   -- get previous stage description    
   insert @PreviousStageDescription    
   select a.StageDescription, a.PermitNo, a.ApplicationNo, d.DateDecision, dbo.GetPermitNumber(a.ApplicationID, a.PermitNo, a.VariationNo) as BPNumber    
   from Application a    
   join dbo.Decision d on a.ApplicationID = d.ApplicationID    
   join dbo.DecisionType dt on d.DecisionTypeID = dt.DecisionTypeID and (dt.MetaType = 1 or dt.MetaType = 2)    
   where a.LicenceID = @LicenceID and a.ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID and a.PermitNo like @PermitNoPrefix + '/%' and convert(int, @PermitNoSuffix) > convert(int, substring(a.PermitNo, @location + 1, len(a.PermitNo) - @location))    
   order by a.PermitNo    
       
   -- Get project cost    
   select @ProjectCost = SUM(a.CostOfDevelopment)     
     from Application a     
     where a.LicenceID = @LicenceID and a.ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID and a.PermitNo like @PermitNoPrefix + '/%' and     
           convert(int, @PermitNoSuffix) >= convert(int, substring(a.PermitNo, @location + 1, len(a.PermitNo) - @location))    
       
   -- Get number of previous stage    
   select @NumofPreviousStages = Count(1) from Application a where a.LicenceID = @LicenceID and a.ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID and a.PermitNo like @PermitNoPrefix + '/%' and convert(int, @PermitNoSuffix) > convert(int, substring(a.PermitNo, @location + 1, len(a.PermitNo) - @location))    
       
   -- Get application number for the first stage permit    
   select @iApplicationNo = applicationno    
   from @PreviousStageDescription    
   order by PermitNo desc    
  end    
 end
